declared: 2026-11-10 implementation of the owner's 2026-10-25 phenotype-primary decision; a post-results amendment, not retrospective preregistration

known_results.limitations: The historical corpus had already been inspected, and both off and phenotype selection-scan results were known as disclosed in the cited amendment. That declaration identifies the recorded off evidence and the phenotype result used outside the repository's recorded evidence. This amendment makes no assertion that study-split results were unseen. It changes the scope roles and reporting contract, not the within-scope statistical rules.

unit: whole study, all experiments and signatures kept together
trait_rule: training Noel sign screen: tested and down > up; p ascending, scored studies descending, trait ID ascending; no forced cellulose
triple_rule: training scan API: exact Feces, exact condition labels, study-disjoint triples only; select one minimum observed mean pairwise Jaccard distance per chosen trait; triple ties are exact (tolerance 0.0) and broken by lexicographically sorted condition tuple; the declared tolerance 1e-12 applies to the scanner U6 comparisons, not triple selection
heldout_null: scanner U6 whole-study-signature null; only held-out studies enter its pool; no replacement of untestable selections
family: per split, every training-selected trait/triple crossed with both statistics; untestable members retained at internal p=1 and exported null
correction: BY primary, BH comparison, using the additive unified engine
heldout_exclusions: undefined distance in any null draw (distance only)
across_splits: descriptive selection/testability/rejection counts only; no pooled p-value, best-split claim or independent-replication claim
interpretation: internal exploratory assessment conditional on U6 exchangeability; not external validation or retrospective preregistration
